words.example: I have got a big family.
The cat is on the sofa.

title.en: Everything together: have got, 's, there is/are, prepositions, some/any
title.ru: Всё вместе: have got, 's, there is/are, предлоги, some/any

rule.en: You can now: say what you have (I have got a sister); say whose it is (my, her, Ann's); say what is in a place (There is / There are); say where (in, on, under, next to); and use some / any. That is enough to describe your home and family.
rule.ru: Теперь ты умеешь: сказать, что у тебя есть (I have got a sister); чьё это (my, her, Ann's); что находится в месте (There is / There are); где (in, on, under, next to); и использовать some / any. Этого хватает, чтобы описать свой дом и семью.

examples.en: There is a sofa next to the window.
I have got a sister. Her name is Kate.
examples.ru: У меня есть сестра. Её зовут Кейт.

pitfalls.en: has got for he/she/it; There is for one, There are for many.
pitfalls.ru: has got для he/she/it; There is для одного, There are для нескольких.

pitfalls.en: some in positives, any in questions/negatives.
pitfalls.ru: some в утверждениях, any в вопросах/отрицаниях.

blocks.en: Welcome to my home! We have got a small flat, but it is very nice. There are three rooms.
blocks.ru: Добро пожаловать ко мне домой! У нас маленькая квартира, но очень хорошая. Здесь три комнаты.

blocks.en: This is my sister. Her name is Kate. Her room is next to the kitchen.
blocks.ru: Это моя сестра. Её зовут Кейт. Её комната рядом с кухней.

blocks.en: There is some food on the table. Our cat is under the chair. We are happy here together.
blocks.ru: На столе есть еда. Наш кот под стулом. Мы счастливы здесь вместе.

dialogue: It is nice! How many rooms are there?
There are three rooms. My sister's room is next to the kitchen.
Здесь три комнаты. Комната сестры рядом с кухней.
Yes, we have got a cat. It is under the chair.
Да, у нас есть кот. Он под стулом.

instruction.en: Complete with have got or has got.
instruction.ru: Вставь have got или has got.

exercises.prompt: Kate is my sister. ___ room is nice.
The cat is ___ the chair (below it).
There is ___ food on the table.
У меня есть сестра. Её зовут Кейт.
answers: I have got a sister. Her name is Kate.
I have a sister. Her name is Kate.
I've got a sister. Her name is Kate.

match: i have got a sister. his name is kate

explanation.en: A sister is a woman → her: Her name is Kate.
explanation.ru: Сестра — женщина → her: Her name is Kate.

answers: There is some food on the table.

match: there is any food on the table
there are some food on the table

explanation.en: Positive + uncountable → There is some food.
explanation.ru: Утверждение + неисчисляемое → There is some food.
